branch_hubs.denominator: Hub concentration = largest immediate-child branch incidence / actual top-list length. Counts ANY eligible narrower-term support including Articles also matching a query directly. Multiple branches can overlap; no summing. Missing rows mean zero narrower-branch incidence.
branch_hubs.sql: SELECT t.seed,t.mode,t.variant,t.k,b.query_descriptor,b.branch,n.name,count(DISTINCT t.article) top_list_incidence,count(DISTINCT t.article) FILTER(WHERE a.direct_matches=0) hierarchy_only_incidence,(SELECT count(*) FROM tops z WHERE z.seed=t.seed AND z.mode=t.mode AND z.variant=t.variant AND z.k=t.k) list_size FROM tops t JOIN branch_hits b USING(seed,mode,article) JOIN attribution a USING(seed,mode,article) JOIN nodes n ON n.id=b.branch GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5,6,7 QUALIFY row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY t.seed,t.mode,t.variant,t.k ORDER BY top_list_incidence DESC,b.query_descriptor,b.branch)<=5 ORDER BY seed,mode,variant,k,top_list_incidence DESC,query_descriptor,branch

candidate_counts.denominator: Same candidates for all scoring variants; score changes only order, none/one/full downward expansion unchanged.
candidate_counts.sql: SELECT seed,mode,count(*) candidates,count(*) FILTER(WHERE direct_matches>0) direct_candidates,count(*) FILTER(WHERE single_subtree_only) single_subtree_only_candidates,count(*) FILTER(WHERE direct_matches=0 AND unresolved>0) unresolved_hierarchy_only_candidates FROM attribution GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

candidate_mode_overlap.denominator: Exact candidate intersections across expansion modes, same query and Article population.
candidate_mode_overlap.sql: SELECT a.seed,a.mode mode_a,b.mode mode_b,count(*) intersection,(SELECT count(*) FROM scores s WHERE s.seed=a.seed AND s.mode=a.mode) count_a,(SELECT count(*) FROM scores s WHERE s.seed=a.seed AND s.mode=b.mode) count_b FROM scores a JOIN scores b ON a.seed=b.seed AND a.article=b.article AND a.mode<b.mode GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3

credit_audit.denominator: Actual descriptor/df/IDF selected for each credited original query descriptor in IDF top 100; one credit maximum per original descriptor.
credit_audit.sql: SELECT c.*,n.name matched_name FROM idf_choice c JOIN nodes n ON n.id=c.matched_descriptor JOIN rankings r USING(seed,mode,article) WHERE r.variant='idf' AND r.rank<=100 ORDER BY c.seed,c.mode,r.rank,c.query_descriptor

descriptor_hubs.denominator: Secondary descriptor hub diagnostic: most frequent expanded non-query descriptor / actual list size. Uses raw eligible support, not just a scoring-selected descriptor.
descriptor_hubs.sql: SELECT t.seed,t.mode,t.variant,t.k,h.matched_descriptor,n.name,count(DISTINCT t.article) top_list_incidence,(SELECT count(*) FROM tops z WHERE z.seed=t.seed AND z.mode=t.mode AND z.variant=t.variant AND z.k=t.k) list_size FROM tops t JOIN hits h USING(seed,mode,article) JOIN nodes n ON n.id=h.matched_descriptor WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM qterms q WHERE q.seed=t.seed AND q.query_descriptor=h.matched_descriptor) GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5,6 QUALIFY row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY t.seed,t.mode,t.variant,t.k ORDER BY top_list_incidence DESC,h.matched_descriptor)<=5 ORDER BY seed,mode,variant,k,top_list_incidence DESC,matched_descriptor

expansion_counts.denominator: Actual vocabulary fan-out, including exported descriptors without any eligible Article; no fabricated closure.
expansion_counts.sql: SELECT seed,mode,count(DISTINCT query_descriptor) query_descriptors,count(DISTINCT matched_descriptor) expanded_descriptors,count(*) descriptor_map_rows FROM expansion GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

guideline_review_first.denominator: Separate guideline/review-first browsing view; core ranking tests remain the declared MeSH scores.
guideline_review_first.sql: SELECT r.*,a.pub_types,a.publication_priority FROM rankings r JOIN article a ON a.id=r.article WHERE starts_with(seed,'topic') AND a.gr QUALIFY row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY seed,mode,variant ORDER BY a.publication_priority,r.rank)<=20 ORDER BY seed,mode,variant,a.publication_priority,r.rank

idf_denominator.denominator: N is distinct Articles with at least one eligible non-check major-topic edge; df(t) is distinct Articles carrying t as an eligible major topic; idf=1+ln((N+1)/(df+1)). No hierarchy aggregation in df.
idf_denominator.sql: SELECT (SELECT count(DISTINCT article) FROM eligible) documents,(SELECT count(*) FROM eligible) distinct_article_descriptor_pairs,(SELECT count(*) FROM idf) descriptors

idf_terms.denominator: Corpus IDF for every query/expanded descriptor, including NULL for zero eligible documents (cannot match an Article).
idf_terms.sql: SELECT DISTINCT e.seed,e.mode,e.query_descriptor,e.matched_descriptor,n.name,d.df,d.idf FROM expansion e LEFT JOIN idf d ON d.descriptor=e.matched_descriptor JOIN nodes n ON n.id=e.matched_descriptor ORDER BY 1,2,3,4

list_metrics.denominator: Share reached only through one unambiguous narrower immediate-child subtree; no direct matches anywhere in the query set. Denominator min(k,candidate_count), not k for short lists.
list_metrics.sql: SELECT t.seed,t.mode,t.variant,t.k,count(*) list_size,count(*) FILTER(WHERE a.single_subtree_only) single_subtree_only_count,count(*) FILTER(WHERE a.single_subtree_only)*1.0/count(*) single_subtree_only_share,count(*) FILTER(WHERE a.direct_matches=0) hierarchy_only_count,count(*) FILTER(WHERE a.direct_matches=0 AND a.branches>1) multi_branch_hierarchy_only_count,count(*) FILTER(WHERE a.direct_matches=0 AND a.unresolved>0) unresolved_hierarchy_only_count FROM tops t JOIN attribution a USING(seed,mode,article) GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY 1,2,3,4

query_sets.denominator: All MedlinePlus topic mappings; all major-topic Article query descriptors, check tags excluded, no single-term reduction.
query_sets.sql: SELECT s.key seed,s.id seed_id,s.kind,s.area,q.query_descriptor,n.name FROM seeds s JOIN qterms q ON q.seed=s.key JOIN nodes n ON n.id=q.query_descriptor ORDER BY 1,5

subtree_audit.denominator: Branch membership witnesses for union of all variants top 100. Branch paths use actual exported immediate-child and ancestor rows; unresolved membership is reported separately.
subtree_audit.sql: SELECT DISTINCT b.*,n.name branch_name FROM branch_hits b JOIN rankings r USING(seed,mode,article) JOIN nodes n ON n.id=b.branch WHERE r.rank<=100 ORDER BY b.seed,b.mode,b.article,b.query_descriptor,b.branch

top100.denominator: Exact top 100 or complete short list for every one of six queries, three modes, three scoring rules. Actual list length is the denominator.
top100.sql: SELECT r.*,a.single_subtree_only,a.branches,a.unresolved FROM rankings r JOIN attribution a USING(seed,mode,article) WHERE rank<=100 ORDER BY seed,mode,variant,rank

top20_overlap.denominator: Top-20 set overlap versus current strict-major downward distance-tier ranking. Short-list denominators retained; Jaccard uses intersection/(variant_size+current_size-intersection).
top20_overlap.sql: SELECT a.seed,a.mode,a.variant,count(*) intersection,(SELECT count(*) FROM rankings r WHERE r.seed=a.seed AND r.mode=a.mode AND r.variant=a.variant AND rank<=20) variant_size,(SELECT count(*) FROM rankings r WHERE r.seed=a.seed AND r.mode=a.mode AND r.variant='current' AND rank<=20) current_size FROM rankings a JOIN rankings b ON a.seed=b.seed AND a.mode=b.mode AND a.article=b.article WHERE a.variant<>'current' AND b.variant='current' AND a.rank<=20 AND b.rank<=20 GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3

toplist_mode_overlap.denominator: Top-20/top-100 intersections across expansion modes; actual list lengths retained.
toplist_mode_overlap.sql: SELECT a.seed,a.variant,a.k,a.mode mode_a,b.mode mode_b,count(*) intersection,(SELECT count(*) FROM tops t WHERE t.seed=a.seed AND t.variant=a.variant AND t.mode=a.mode AND t.k=a.k) count_a,(SELECT count(*) FROM tops t WHERE t.seed=a.seed AND t.variant=a.variant AND t.mode=b.mode AND t.k=a.k) count_b FROM tops a JOIN tops b ON a.seed=b.seed AND a.article=b.article AND a.variant=b.variant AND a.k=b.k AND a.mode<b.mode GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5 ORDER BY 1,2,3,4,5
